authority_note: HRIS is canonical for titles, department, manager, and status. Email signatures and external notes are NOT authoritative for titles.
Recognized revenue and recognized ARR come from the General Ledger. This overrides any figure stated in decks, chat, CRM, or by an executive.
Credits and adjustments (e.g. disputed-invoice credit memos) are recognized in the GL; the recognized figure reflects them.
CRM is the system of record for pipeline stage, account owner, segment, and contract-list (booked) ARR. It is NOT the system of record for recognized revenue — use Finance GL for that.
Access entitlements and their review decisions come from the IAM access review, not from tickets or chat.
Incident timeline, severity, and uptime come from the status page. Authoritative but short-lived: operational state decays fast.
Current product-spec sections and current KB pages define API limits and behavior. Deprecated sections and superseded KB revisions are historical, not current.
Current KB revision (latest version field) is authoritative for API behavior; older page_history revisions are superseded.
Org decisions and strategic direction come from the DACI decision log. Strategy docs and proposals advocate; they do not decide.
The approved policy version is authoritative for retention. Draft versions (any status other than approved) are not, regardless of date.
